visualCharacteristics: A row of repeating pricing tiles, each with an audience label, tier name, price, a checkmark feature list, and a select button. Buttons align along the bottom edge.
contentPattern: One row per tile; each tile holds an audience label, tier name, price, a bulleted feature list, and a CTA link.
usage: Pricing / membership tier comparison (e.g. Free / Rally / Pro / Pro Plus).
